plugins.name: manuscript-review-annotator
plugins.description: Review a research manuscript (Word .docx, LaTeX source or PDF) thoroughly and deliver the review as an interactive annotation page — the full paper with figures and tables, every issue pre-highlighted in the text or boxed on the figure, shareable with co-authors, who can also edit the manuscript text right in the page to address the notes (tracked changes, one-click suggestions) — plus clean exports, a standalone read-only report, and a patch that carries the page's text edits back into the LaTeX source.
